statement: The identity MUST be `intent_` + first 12 characters of the lowercase hexadecimal SHA-1 digest; no other algorithm, length, case or prefix conforms.
note: Five plausible readings of an under-specified digest rule, each of which an implementation might reach honestly. `sha256_full_no_prefix` is the one an independent implementer actually chose from the earlier draft, which named the four inputs and the joiner and said nothing about hash function, encoding, length or prefix. `sha1_first_12_uppercase` is the near-miss worth calling out: the right algorithm and the right truncation, in the wrong case, forks every id all the same.
